lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data on a monthly basis throughout 2011 across Uganda. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for four observation periods (January, April, July, October). The dataset represents post-event or ongoing food insecurity assessments linked to underlying hazards such as drought.
